newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong blaze death toll lowered to 37.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong blaze death toll lowered to 37.

text.p: Hong Kong police on Friday issued a revised death toll for the territory's worst building blaze on record, reducing it to 37 from an earlier figure of 39.

Police Senior Superintendent Victor Lo said police believed the final toll was 37, not 39. He said the latest count was reached after comparing reports of people said to be missing with the number of bodies found in the burned building.

The inferno, believed to have been caused by sparks from welding work in a lift shaft, gutted six floors of the Garley Building in the "golden mile" Nathan Road tourist shopping district on Wednesday and Thursday.
The revised toll remained the worst on record for a blaze in a single high-rise building in the British colony's century and a half-long history. An inquiry into the fire is under way.
